wiki_only_topics.topic: Roman history as Osca and Sertorius
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: During Roman times, the city was known as Osca, and was a Roman colony under the rule of Quintus Sertorius, who made Osca his base.
The Arabs conquered the city in the late 8th century, and the city came to be called Washqah (وشقة in Arabic)
It was the capital of the Kingdom of Aragon between 1096 and 1118.
In 1354, King Peter IV of Aragon founded the University of Huesca, which initially had a faculty of theology.
